text.p: The Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust Plc said it believes that hostile bidder TR European Growth Fund cannot put a firm offer on the table because of the costs associated with the disposal of KEPIT's portfolio.
"Their statement is complete nonsense," said a spokesman for KEPIT.

TREG said on Friday that its offer valued KEPIT at 97.3 pence per share under its cash bid and the warrants at 29.2 pence, making a total of 103.1 pence for a package of one share and one fifth of a warrant.
